name: Municipal Parking Ticket Management System

data.label: Parking Violation Detected
data.description: Initiates the parking ticket management workflow when an enforcement officer detects a violation

data.label: Issue Parking Ticket
data.instructions: Record vehicle details, violation type, location, time, and issue digital ticket

data.label: Validate Ticket Information
data.description: Validates all ticket information meets municipal standards and requirements

data.label: Validation Check
data.condition: Check if ticket data is valid
data.description: Routes based on validation results

data.label: Generate Error Report
data.script: Generate validation error report for officer
data.description: Creates detailed error report for ticket correction

data.label: Multi-Channel Notification
data.branches: Send notifications via multiple channels simultaneously
data.description: Parallel notification to vehicle owner through available channels

data.label: Lookup Vehicle Owner
data.script: Query vehicle registration database to find owner details
data.description: Retrieves owner information from DMV database integration

data.label: Send Email Notification
data.description: Emails ticket details and payment/appeal options to owner

data.label: Send SMS Alert
data.description: Sends SMS alert with ticket number and quick payment link

data.label: Join Notifications
data.description: Waits for all notification channels to complete

data.label: Wait for Citizen Response
data.description: 30-day window for citizen to pay or appeal ticket

data.label: Citizen Action Decision
data.description: Routes based on whether citizen pays, appeals, or takes no action

data.label: Process Payment
data.script: Integrate with payment gateway to process citizen payment
data.description: Handles secure payment processing through integrated payment gateway

data.label: Submit Appeal
data.instructions: Citizen submits appeal with evidence and reasoning

data.label: Generate Late Notice
data.prompt: Generate a formal late payment notice for parking ticket ${processData.ticket_number} with escalated fine amount and collection warning
data.description: AI generates personalized late notice with escalation warnings

data.label: Review Appeal
data.instructions: Administrator reviews appeal evidence and makes determination

data.label: AI Appeal Analysis
data.prompt: Analyze this parking ticket appeal: ${processData.appeal_text}. Consider evidence: ${processData.appeal_evidence}. Provide recommendation for approval/denial with reasoning based on municipal parking regulations.
data.description: AI analyzes appeal merits and provides recommendation to administrator

data.label: Appeal Decision
data.description: Routes based on appeal approval or denial

data.label: Close Ticket - Appeal Approved
data.script: Update ticket status to dismissed, record appeal approval, refund payment if made
data.description: Closes ticket due to successful appeal and handles refund if applicable

data.label: Maintain Ticket - Appeal Denied
data.script: Update ticket status to upheld, record denial reason, maintain fine amount
data.description: Maintains original ticket with appeal denial documentation

data.label: Final Notification Split
data.branches: Send final notifications and update records
data.description: Parallel final processing tasks

data.label: Notify Citizen of Decision
data.description: Informs citizen of final appeal decision and next steps

data.label: Update Analytics Dashboard
data.description: Updates real-time analytics and reporting dashboard

data.label: Join Final Processing
data.branches: Merge final notification and data update
data.description: Waits for all final processing tasks to complete

data.label: Ticket Process Complete
data.result: Parking ticket fully processed with payment or appeal resolution
data.description: Workflow completes with ticket status finalized and all parties notified

dataModels.name: ParkingTicket
dataModels.description: Stores parking violation ticket information including vehicle details, violation type, and payment status

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique ticket identifier/number

fields.name: licensePlate
fields.description: Vehicle license plate number

fields.name: violationType
fields.description: Type of parking violation (e.g., expired meter, no parking zone)

fields.name: location
fields.description: Street address or coordinates where violation occurred

fields.name: issuedAt
fields.description: Date and time when ticket was issued

fields.name: fineAmount
fields.description: Monetary amount of the fine in dollars

fields.name: status
fields.description: Current ticket status (e.g., unpaid, paid, appealed, dismissed)

fields.name: issuingOfficerId
fields.description: ID of the officer who issued the ticket

dataModels.name: EnforcementOfficer
dataModels.description: Maintains enforcement officer profiles and assignment information for parking ticket issuance tracking and accountability

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the enforcement officer

fields.name: badgeNumber
fields.description: Official badge number for officer identification

fields.name: fullName
fields.description: Full name of the enforcement officer

fields.name: contactPhone
fields.description: Contact phone number for the officer

fields.name: assignedZones
fields.description: Comma-separated list of zone codes assigned to the officer

fields.name: isActive
fields.description: Indicates whether the officer is currently active for duty

fields.name: ticketsIssued
fields.description: Total count of parking tickets issued by this officer

dataModels.name: Payment
dataModels.description: Tracks all payment transactions associated with parking tickets including amount, method, status, and payment history

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the payment transaction

fields.name: parkingTicketId
fields.description: Reference to the associated parking ticket

fields.name: amount
fields.description: Payment amount in currency units

fields.name: paymentMethod
fields.description: Method of payment (credit_card, debit_card, cash, online, check)

fields.name: transactionId
fields.description: External transaction identifier from payment processor

fields.name: paymentStatus
fields.description: Current status of payment (pending, completed, failed, refunded)

fields.name: paymentDate
fields.description: Date and time when payment was made

relationships.description: Each payment is associated with one parking ticket

constraints.paymentMethod: Must be one of: credit_card, debit_card, cash, online, check
constraints.paymentStatus: Must be one of: pending, completed, failed, refunded

dataModels.name: Appeal
dataModels.description: Manages citizen appeals and disputes for parking tickets with complete audit trail

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the appeal

fields.name: ticketId
fields.description: Reference to the parking ticket being appealed

fields.name: reason
fields.description: Citizen's explanation for disputing the ticket

fields.name: submissionDate
fields.description: Date and time when the appeal was submitted

fields.name: status
fields.description: Current review status (pending, under_review, approved, rejected)

fields.name: reviewerId
fields.description: Reference to the enforcement officer or reviewer assigned to the appeal

fields.name: decision
fields.description: Final resolution decision with notes explaining the outcome

fields.name: decisionDate
fields.description: Date when the appeal decision was made

routing.reasoning: This is a complex municipal system with 10+ workflow nodes, multiple decision branches (pay/appeal), parallel processing paths, and sub-workflows. It's primarily an approval domain for ticket processing and appeals. Requires SQL for relational data (tickets, vehicles, citizens, payments), advanced forms for validation and business rules, mobile support for field officers, and ensemble approach due to multiple specialized components working together.
